description: Prostrate, stem zigzag, sparsely pilose. Leaves lying flat on ground; petiole 0–3 mm; lamina ovate-oblong, 2.1–3.6 by 1.9–2.6 cm, base cordate, margin entire ± uneven and repand, apex rounded, upper surface glabrous, rough or scabrous, lower surface hirsute, densely hirsute when young, palmately 5–7-nerved. Flowers solitary, without floral bracts; pedicels 1–1.5 cm, laxly minutely hirsute; ovary 5–9 by 1–2 mm, densely hairy. Perianth 3.5–5 cm, utricle spherical or ovoid, 4–8 by 3–6 mm, tube 2–3 by 0.2–0.3 cm, limb linear 1.5–2 by 0.2–0.4 cm, apex obtuse, reddish-brown. Anthers oblong, 0.9–1 by 0.4–0.5 mm. Gynostemium 2.6 by 1.6 mm, stigmatic lobes 6, longer than the anther, slightly curved inwards. Fruit broadly ellipsoid, ± 1.5 by 1.2–1.5 cm; pedicel 1–1.5 cm. Seeds triangular-obovate, not winged, 4.5 by 4.5 mm, thick and convex at the apex, verrucose on one side, the other side brown.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aristolochia arenicola. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 1, 1987. Pg. 3. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Climber, stem glabrous. Leaves: petiole 4–7.5 cm, glabrous; lamina deeply 3-lobed to within 2–3 cm from the base, slightly 3-lobed when young, lobes subequal, the central lobe oblong-lanceolate, slightly longer than lateral ones, acuminate, 3-nerved, the lateral ones obliquely obovate-oblong, 9–11.5 by 3–4 cm, obtuse, 2-nerved. Inflorescences 1–2, axillary, racemose, 5–7 cm; bracts amplexicaul cordate, rose-coloured, 0.5–1.7 cm. Flowers few; pedicels 3–4 mm; ovary 5–6 by 1 mm, glabrous. Perianth 4–5 cm, dark blue; utricle narrowly ovoid, 1.3–1.5 by 0.6–0.7 cm, tube short cylindrical, 0.4–0.6 by 0.1–0.2 cm, limb subsagittate, 2–2.5 by 0.6–1 cm. Anthers broadly oblong or suborbicular 0.6–0.7 by 0.25–0.3 mm. Gynostemium 1–1.1 by 2–2.5 mm, stigmatic lobes 6, small conical. Fruit oblong, 3–3.5 by 1.5–1.7 cm base cuneate, apex mucronate; pedicel 1.8–2 cm. Seeds ovate to triangular-ovate, not winged, ± 5 by 4 mm, verrucose on both sides, light brown.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aristolochia curtisii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 1, 1987. Pg. 8. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Woody climber, stem glabrous. Leaves with pseudo-stipules, leaf-like, amplexicaul, ± 1.2 by 2 cm; petiole 3.5–4 cm, slender, glabrous; lamina triangular 4–5.5 by 6–7 cm, base cordate, margin entire, apex rounded or obtuse, glabrous on both sides, but young leaves pubescent, palmately finely 3-nerved, venation reticulate, obscured. Flowers solitary, large; pedicel and ovary 7–8.5 cm. Perianth white or greenish with purple-black mottlings; utricle obliquely ellipsoid, 2.5–3 by 1.2–1.5 cm, tube bent upwards, 1.2–2 by ± 0.5 cm, limb orbicular, 5–7 cm diam. Anthers linear, ± 4 by 1 mm. Gynostemium ± 5.8 by 4.5 mm, stigmatic lobes 6, flattened, outside apically pubescent, with margins recurved outwards. Fruit not seen.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aristolochia elegans. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 1, 1987. Pg. 13. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Woody climber, branches glabrescent. Leaves: petiole 3.5–9 cm, pubescent; lamina broad-oblong, oblong-ovate, elliptic, obovate or oblong-obovate, 11.5–25 by 6.5–15 cm, base rounded or cuneate, margin entire or ± undulate, apex obtuse ± cuspidate rarely retuse, glabrous above, villous below, pinnately 6–7-nerved, veins transverse, venation reticulate, conspicuous above, prominent below. Inflorescences racemose, few-flowered, brown tomentose; bracts ovate ± 2 by 1 mm. Flowers with slender pedicels, 3.5–7.5 cm, bent at the top; ovary 1–2 by 0.2–0.4 cm. Perianth 5.5–6 cm, white, outside, yellow inside, veins brown; utricle obliquely ovoid, 2–3 by 0.8–0.9 cm, bent upwards, tube obliquely funnel-shaped 1.6–1.8 cm, lower part 0.4 cm, upper part 1–1.2 cm diam., margin of the tube recurved, tuberculate. Anthers oblong, ± 2.5 by 1.5 mm. Gynostemium 4.5–4.8 by 4–4.3 mm, stigmatic lobes 6, ovate, obtuse, slightly curved inwards. Fruit ± 13 by 3 cm (immature), longitudinally 6-angled, pubescent, greyish-black.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aristolochia grandis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 1, 1987. Pg. 20. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stem zigzag, tomentose. Leaves: petiole 0.3–0.6 cm; lamina lanceolate or ovate, 6.1–10.7 by 1.9–3.2 cm; base cordate; margin entire ± repand or undulate, apex acute or obtuse; upper surface puberulous, lower surface velutinous; pinnately 7–8-nerved, venation reticulate, slightly visible above, prominent below. Inflorescences densely racemose, densely velutinous; bracts ovate or lanceolate 2.5–3 by 1.2–1.6 mm. Flowers with pedicels 0.2–0.3 cm; ovary 0.3–0.5 by 0.15–0.2 cm. Perianth 3–3.5 cm, purple or brown; utricle spherical or ovoid 0.4–0.45 by 0.3–0.4 cm, tube ± 0.8 by 0.2 cm, limb nearly orbicular, ± 1.2 by 1 cm, apex rounded or emarginate, glabrous above. Anthers ellipsoid, about 0.8 by 0.4 mm. Gynostemium 1.6–1.8 by 1.8–3 mm, stigmatic lobes 6, long conical, obtuse. Fruit ovoid, 1.2–1.6 by 1.2–1.5 cm; velutinous pedicel 6–7.5 mm. Seeds triangular-obcordate, not winged, ± 2.3 by 2.2 mm, verrucose.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aristolochia harmandiana. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 1, 1987. Pg. 3. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Prostrate herb. Stem zigzag, very slender, scabrous or villous. Leaves: petiole 2.2–5 mm, slender, scabrous or villous; lamina broadly ovate, 8–14 by 8–14 mm, base cordate, margin entire, apex acute or acuminate, upper surface scabrous, lower surface tomentose or villous, palmately 3–5-nerved, venation reticulate, inconspicuous above, prominent beneath. Flowers solitary, without bracts; pedicels 4–5 mm, slender, pubescent or villous; ovary 2–3 by 0.5 mm, pubescent or villous. Perianth 14–17 mm, glabrous outside, utricle spherical or ovoid, 2–2.5 by 2–2.5 mm, tube 5–9 by 1–1.5 mm, limb 1-lipped, oblong, 7–8 by 3 mm, obtuse. Anthers oblong ± 0.5 by 0.3 mm. Gynostemium ± 1.5 by 1.3 mm, stigmatic lobes 6, conical, obtuse. Fruit spherical ± 7 mm diam.; pedicel ± 5 mm. Seeds obovate or ± obcordate, not winged, ± 3.2 by 2.8 mm, smooth on both surfaces or slightly verrucose on one side.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aristolochia helix. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 1, 1987. Pg. 6. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Climber, stem glabrous. Leaves: petiole 2 3–3.2 cm, glabrous; lamina ovate-lanceolate, triangular, triangular-ovate to broadly ovate, 5.2–7.4 by 4.5–6.6 cm, base truncate or ± cordate, margin entire, apex acute to acuminate, glabrous above, puberulous below, gland-dotted on both sides, palmately 5-nerved, venation finely reticulate, obscure above, prominent below. Inflorescences axillary, fascicled racemes 1.5–3 cm long, puberulous; bracts lanceolate, 0.5–1.2 by 0.2–0.5 cm longitudinally veined, densely gland-dotted. Flowers with 0.8–1.1 cm pedicel & ovary 2–3 by 0.5–1 mm. Perianth 1.3–2 cm, purple, inside cream; utricle spherical or ovoid, 2.9–4.7 by 2.7–4.1 mm, tube 3.1–7.5 by 1.3–2 mm, bent on transition from utricle, limb sagittate, 0.7–1.4 by 0.4–1.2 cm. Anthers ellipsoid, 0.5–0.6 by 0.8–1 mm. Gynostemium 0.8–1.8 by 1.2–3.6 mm, stigmatic lobes 6, short, obtuse. Fruit ovoid, 1.8–2.2 by 1.6–1.8 cm; pedicel 1.8–2.2 cm. Seeds obovate, flat, not winged, 4–4.5 by 2.3–2.6 mm, verrucose on both sides.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aristolochia kerrii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 1, 1987. Pg. 18. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Climber, stem glabrous. Leaves: petiole 0.9–1.5(–3.5) cm, grooved above, hairy along edges, glabrous beneath; lamina lanceolate to broadly lanceolate, 8.5–13.8 by 2.8–4.6 cm, base cordate, margin entire, slightly recurved, hairy above, apex acute or tapering acute, upper surface finely pubescent, lower surface puberulous, with scattered gland-dots on both sides, palmately 5-nerved, lateral nerves 3–4, venation reticulate, conspicuous above, prominent below. Inflorescences racemose, 3.5–7 cm, tomentose; bracts lanceolate or narrowly lanceolate, 0.8–1.2 by 0.35–0.45 cm both sides hairy. Flowers with 0.4–1 cm pedicels, slender; ovary 3.7–4.5 by 0.5–1 mm. Perianth 2–3.5 cm, utricle spherical or ovoid, 3.5–4.5 by 3–4 mm, purple inside, tube 5–8.5 by ± 1 mm, greenish light brown, limb oblong, 1–1.5 by 0.45–0.55 cm, purplish-brown. Anthers oblong ± 0.4 by 0.2 mm. Gynostemium 1.8–2.1 mm, stigmatic lobes 6, long conical, obtuse. Fruit ovoid, 2–2.5 by 1.8–2 cm; pedicel 3.2–4.5 cm. Seeds broadly obcordate or triangular, winged, 4.7–5.1 by 5.5–6 mm, verrucose on both sides.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aristolochia pierrei. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 1, 1987. Pg. 15. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Climber, stem laxly adpressed puberulous. Leaves: petiole 3.5–5.2 cm, puberulous; lamina entire or 3-lobed, broadly ovate, lobes less than half the length of the lamina, 11–11.5 by 12–13.6 cm, base deeply cordate, apex acute, acuminate or obtuse, lateral lobes obtuse, laxly pubescent and gland-dotted on both sides, palmately 3-nerved with transverse nerves conspicuous above and prominent beneath. Inflorescences axillary panicles, 6 cm, densely puberulous; bracts ovate or lanceolate, ± 1 by 0.5 mm. Flowers with pedicels 6–7 mm; ovary 6–8 by 1–1.2 mm, densely pubescent. Perianth 2.4–4.4 cm, brown, purplish, reddish, straight; utricle spherical or ovoid, 3.5–7.5 by 3.3–4 mm; tube 0.8–1.6 by 0.1–0.2 cm; limb obovate, oblong or spathulate, 1.3–1.8 by 0.5–0.7 cm. Anthers ellipsoid, 0.7–0.9 by 0.7–0.9 mm. Gynostemium 2–2.2 by 2.7–3 mm, stigmatic lobes 6, conical, obtuse. Fruit ovoid, 4–4.5 by 2.5–3 cm; pedicel 5–6 cm. Seeds triangular-obcordate, thin, winged, 7.5–8 by 6.7–7 mm, verrucose on one side the other side smooth, brown.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aristolochia pothieri. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 1, 1987. Pg. 10. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Climber, stem glabrous; the whole plant gland-dotted. Leaves with pseudo-stipules, leaf-like, reniform, unequal, the bigger one 1.5–2.5 by 2–3 cm, the smaller one 0.6–1.5 by 1–2 cm; petiole 3–8 cm, slender, glabrous; lamina reniform, 5–10 by 7.5–14.5 cm, base deeply cordate, margin entire, apex rounded, ± cuspidate, glabrous, but young leaves slightly pubescent, palmately nerved, nerves branched near the margin, venation reticulate. Flowers solitary, large, dark red or dark purple; pedicel ± 6.5 cm; ovary 2.5–4.5 by 0.1–0.2 cm. Perianth 17.5–27 cm; utricle obliquely ellipsoid, 4–7.5 by 3–4 cm, tube bent upwards, 2–2.5 by 0.6–0.8 cm, limb 2-lipped, upper lip spathulate, 4.5–6 cm, reticulate, lower lip oblong-lanceolate, 9–15 cm, apex obtuse. Anthers linear, 5.5 by 0.8 mm. Gynostemium ± 8 by 5 mm, stigmatic lobes 6, long conical, obtuse. Fruit oblong, 7–7.5 by 3–3.5 cm; pedicel 10–12 cm, strongly 6-ribbed. Seeds including wing obovate, 9–12 by 5–7.5 mm, seed proper obcordate, 3–3.5 by 2.5–3.5 mm, brown with light brown verrucae, the other side dark brown, wing light brown.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aristolochia ringens. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 1, 1987. Pg. 12. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Climber, young stem pubescent, glabrescent. Leaves: petioles 3–6 cm, grooved above, pubescent along grooved surface, glabrous below; lamina ovate to ovate-lanceolate, 9.5–16.5 by 5.8–7.6 cm, base deeply cordate, margin entire ± recurved, apex acuminate, mature leaves glabrous on both sides, nerves and veins ± pubescent, laxly gland-dotted; palmately 3-nerved, pinnately 3–4-nerved along the midrib, veins transverse, venation reticulate, obscurely above, prominent below. Inflorescences paniculate or racemose, 6–13.5 cm, pubescent to nearly glabrous; bracts ovate, 1.8–3 by 1–1.5 mm, base cuneate, margin ciliate, apex acute, puberulous on both surfaces. Flowers with pedicel 5–8 mm; ovary 5–9.7 by 1–1.5 mm. Perianth 3.6–5 cm long, greenish, dark purple hairy inside, laxly hairy outside; utricle globular, 5–6.5 by 5–7 mm, tube 0.6–1.2 by 1–1.5 mm, limb linear-lanceolate, 1.6–2.5 by ± 0.8 cm. Anthers ellipsoid ± 1 by 0.8–1.7 mm. Gynostemium 3–4 by 3.5–4 mm, stigmatic lobes 6, long conical, obtuse. Fruit ovoid, 3.3–5.5 by 2.7–4.3 cm; pedicel 3.3–5.8 cm. Seeds broadly obovate ± obcordate, winged, 5–7.5 by 7–7.5 mm, laxly verrucose on one side, the other side smooth, light brown.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aristolochia tagala. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 1, 1987. Pg. 15. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Climber, stem pubescent. Leaves: petiole 1–2 cm, adpressed hairy; lamina oblanceolate, oblong-oblanceolate or elliptic oblong, 11.2–17.5 by 3.4–4.7 cm, base narrowly slightly cordate, margin entire ± undulate with adpressed hairs, apex acuminate, upper surface laxly pilose, with scattered gland-dots, or nearly glabrous, lower surface pubescent, midrib and nerves adpressed hairy on both sides, pinnately 9–10-nerved, venation reticulate, prominent beneath conspicuous above. Inflorescences racemose, 1–3-flowered, ± 10 cm long; bracts very small, densely yellowish long pilose. Flowers with 1–2 cm pedicels, slender, brown pilose; ovary 1.2–1.6 by 0.2–0.25 cm, brown pilose. Perianth 6–7 cm, brown with purple veins, inside glabrous, outside yellowish pilose; utricle ovoid, 0.8–1 by 0.8–1.2 cm, tube 1.3–2.3 by 0.5–0.7 cm, limb patent, 4.6–5 cm diam. Anthers oblong, 2–3.5 by 0.8–0.9 mm. Gynostemium 3.8–5.2 by 2–2.3 mm, stigmatic lobes 3, ovate, obtuse. Fruit not seen.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aristolochia versicolor. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 1, 1987. Pg. 18. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree 6–15 m high, stunted and crooked; young leaves, thyrse, calyx and corolla sparsely stiff-stellate-hairy, later more or less glabrescent. Leaves 13–27 cm long; leaflets 4–7-pairs, ovate-lanceolate or oblong-lanceolate, 3.6–7.5 by 1.7–2.8 cm, base usually oblique, obscurely blunt serrate or crenate to subentire; petiolules 2–5 mm long. Thyrse 16–28 cm long. Calyx tubular-campanuiate, 1.1–1.5 cm long, with scattered, slightly warty glands. Corolla tube 3–4 cm long, cylindric basal tube 8–12 mm long, suddenly tubular-campanulate widened above, 2.3–3.3 cm long, pinkish-white in the lower part, pink to pinkish-mauve in the upper. Capsule 12–16 cm long; valves 2.8–3.8 cm broad, with scattered, sessile glands; pseudoseptum ca 2.1 cm broad. Seeds ca 2.8 by 1.3 cm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Barnettia kerrii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 1, 1987. Pg. 58. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree 8–20 m high. Leaves 17–35 cm long; leaflets 5–10 pairs, ovate-lanceolate or oblong-lanceolate, 5–7 by 2–3 cm, base obtuse, slightly oblique, subentire, glabrous; petiolules 1–5 mm long. Thyrse 20–35 cm long, peduncles and pedicels usually with scattered, minute tuberculate glands, sparsely pilose, later glabrescent. Calyx tubular, 1.5–1.9 cm long with dense, minute tuberculate to warty glands. Corolla tube straight, gradually and narrowly funnel-shaped, widened towards the mouth, 4.5–5.5 cm long, white to pale lilac, with greenish-yellow throat. Capsule 10–16 cm long, valves 2.6–3.3 cm broad with dense, minute tuberculate glands; pseudoseptum ca 1.7 cm broad. Seeds ca 2.6 by 1.1 cm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Barnettia pagetii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 1, 1987. Pg. 58. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Vigorous climbing shrub with aerial rootlets. Leaflets 4–6 pairs, serrate to crenate, pubescent below, subsessile. Calyx reddish-orange; deeply lobed; lobes acute to short acuminate or mucronate. Corolla tube 2 to 3 times longer than calyx, reddish-orange; lobes 1.5–2.5 cm wide, rather dark dull red inside. Two longest stamens about equal to corolla tube.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Campsis radicans. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 1, 1987. Pg. 61. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Herbs, up to 35 cm high; stems moderately branched, quadrangular. Leaves all cauline, narrowly ovate, 2–5 by 1–2.5 cm, not transparent; apex acute. Bracts ovate-lanceolate, herbaceous, up to 1 cm long. Inflorescence lax; flowers up to 3 cm long; pedicels up to 1.5 cm long. Calyx herbaceous, 8–ribbed; tube cyclindrical, 11 by 2.8 mm; lobes 4, dentate, 2 mm long. Corolla white or purple; tube cylindrical, 15 cm long; lobes 4, 2 broader than the others, obovate, 6–8 mm long, apex acute. Stamens 4; filaments unequal, inserted at different levels of the upper part of the corolla tube, the longest 1.8 mm long, 3 shorter 0.3 mm long; anthers ovoid, 1.3 mm long. Ovary elliptic; style 11.5 mm long; stigma bifid. Capsule elliptic, 8 by 2.5 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Canscora andrographioides. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 1, 1987. Pg. 77. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Herbs, 13–25 cm high; stems simple, 4-winged. Leaves basal rosette, 15–20 by 10–13 mm; cauline much smaller, lanceolate, boat-shaped, adpressed to the stem, 3–5 by 1–3 mm, not transparent; apex acute. Bracts ovate, boat-shaped, scarious, 1–2 mm long. Flowers fascicled, 1 cm long; pedicels 0.1 mm long. Calyx membranous, often 2-winged; tube cylindrical, 4–5 mm long; lobes 4, deltoid, 1.5 mm long; apex acute. Corolla white; tube cylindrical, constricted half-way, brownish, 7 mm long; lobes 4, ovate, 3 mm long, apex obtuse. Stamens 4; filaments equal, inserted near the throat, 2 mm long; anthers oblong, 1 mm long. Ovary oblong; style 3–5 mm long; stigma capitate. Capsule oblong, 3–5 mm long, 1–1.5 mm across.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Canscora carinata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 1, 1987. Pg. 73. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Herbs, 8–50 cm high; stems copiously branched, 4-winged. Leaves all cauline, ovate or oblong-lanceolate, 10 by 0.6 mm, not transparent; apex acute. Bracts oblong-lanceolate, herbaceous, 2 mm long. Inflorescence lax; flowers 1–1.5 mm long; pedicels up to 2.2 cm long. Calyx herbaceous, 4-winged; tube cylindrical, 8 by 1.6 mm; lobes 4, dentate, 1 mm long. Corolla white; tube cylindrical, as long as calyx; lobes 4, 2 smaller than the others, obovate, 6 mm long, apex obtuse. Stamens 4; filaments equal, inserted in the upper part of the corolla tube, 2 mm long; anthers oblong, 1.5 mm long. Ovary subcylindrical; style 6 mm long; stigma bilobed. Capsule subcylindrical, 5 by 1 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Canscora decussata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 1, 1987. Pg. 74. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Herbs, 5–80 cm high; stems copiously branched, quadrangular. Leaves all cauline, lower ones elliptic to elliptic-oblong, 4 by 1 cm, thin and semitransparent; apex acute; upper leaves cordate, 1.7 by 1 cm; apex acute. Bracts ovate, membranous, 1–1.5 mm long. Inflorescence lax; flowers up to 1.5 cm long; pedicels up to 1.5 cm long. Calyx herbaceous, 4-ribbed; tube cylindrical, 6 by 1.5 mm; lobes 4, dentate, 1.5 mm long. Corolla pink; tube cyclindrical, 7 mm long; lobes 4, 2 connate higher than the others, elliptic, 4 mm long, apex round. Stamens 4; filaments equal, inserted in the tube near the throat at different levels; anthers narrowly ovoid, 1.1 mm long. Ovary oblong; style 3 mm long; stigma bifid. Capsule oblong, 7 by 1.5 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Canscora diffusa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 1, 1987. Pg. 77. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Herbs, up to 60 cm high; stems moderately branched, terete. Leaves all cauline, connate-perfoliate and radiately nerved, 1–3 cm across, not transparent; apex broadly acute. Bracts as leaves. Flowers solitary, up to 0.9 cm long. Pedicels 0.5–1.5 cm long. Calyx herbaceous, terete; tube urceolate, 7 by 5 mm; lobes 4, broadly triangular, 1–1.5 mm long. Corolla white; tube urceolate, as long as calyx; lobes 4, broadly lingular, 2–3 mm long. Stamens 4; filaments equal, inserted near the base of the narrow part of the corolla-tube, 2–3 mm long; anthers oblong, 1 mm long. Ovary ovoid, style 3–5 mm long; stigma capitate. Capsule subglobular, 5 by 3 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Canscora helferiana. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 1, 1987. Pg. 76. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Herbs, up to 50 cm high; stems moderately branched, quadrangular. Leaves all cauline, ovate or ovate-lanceolate, thin and semi-transparent, 2–7 by 1–4 mm; apex acute. Bracts linear-lanceolate, herbaceous, 1 mm long. Inflorescence lax; flowers 0.8 cm long; pedicels up to 1.2 cm long. Calyx scarious; 6-winged; tube urceolate, 6.5 by 5.1 mm; lobes 6, dentate, 1 mm long. Corolla white; tube subcylindric-infundibular, 8 mm long; lobes 6, oblong, 2 mm long, apex obtuse. Stamens 6; filaments equal, inserted below the middle of the corolla, 3 mm long; anthers oblong, 1 mm long. Ovary obovoid; style 4 mm long; stigma capitate. Capsule obovoid, 3 by 2.5 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Canscora hexagona. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 1, 1987. Pg. 76. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Herbs, up to 50 cm high; stems copiously branched, terete. Leaves all cauline, ovate-lanceolate, not transparent, 1.5–5.5 by 0.5–2 cm; apex acute or acuminate. Bracts herbaceous, connate-perfoliate at base, ± ovate, 13.5 by 7 mm. Inflorescence lax; flowers 1.3 cm long; pedicels 5.5 mm long. Calyx scarious, 3-winged; tube urceolate, 8 by 5 mm; lobes 3, broadly triangular, 2 mm long. Corolla white; tube urceolate, 10 mm long; lobes 6, oblong, 3 mm long, apex obtuse. Stamens 6; filaments equal, inserted more or less at the middle of the corolla, 6 mm long; anthers oblong, 1.5 mm long. Ovary ellipsoid; style 6.5 mm long; stigma capitate. Capsule ellipsoid, 6.5 by 2.5 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Canscora pentanthera. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 1, 1987. Pg. 74. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Liana up to 8 m, often with hanging branches, or erect shrub with spiny stem. Leaves glabrous, ovate to lanceolate or elliptic, (3–)5–9(–13) by 1.5–4(–5) cm; apex acuminate; base shortly attenuate to attenuate; petiole 3–5 mm, densely hairy. Spikes 1–4 in the axil of one leaf, 1.3–2.5(–4) cm long when flowering, usually with more than 8 flowers; bracts ovate to triangular, 1 mm long. Perianth urceolate, greenish-yellow, tube (2–)2.5–3 mm long; lobes recurved, 0.5 mm. Filaments filiform, ca 2 mm; anthers broadly oval, reaching as far as the throat. Disc-scales ovate, ca 0.7 mm long, slightly fleshy. Ovary ca 1 mm long; style ca 1 mm long, the 4-lobed stigma a little exceeding the tube of the perianth. Drupe orange, 10–13 by 7–9 mm.

description: Small tree up to 10 m or shrub. Leaves glabrous, ovate, oblong, or lanceolate, 6–13(–20) by 2–8(–11) cm; apex slightly acuminate; base shortly attenuate to attenuate; petiole 3–5 mm. description: Deciduous tree, 5–13(–20) m high; innovations, thyrse and calyx with rusty stellate tomentum. description: Shrub 1–5 m or small trees rarely up to 20 m tall, branchlets glabrous. description: Shrub or small tree up to 10 m tall, branchlets rufous pilose. Leaves obovate-oblong or obovate, 15–26 by 7–12 cm, shortly acuminate, acute or obtuse, attenuate, ± decurrent along the short thick petiole, base subcordate truncate or subacute, margin mostly rather regularly and coarsely serrate, subcoriaceous, finely appressed hairs all over the undersurface, glabrescent and finally entirely glabrous, midrib prominent on both sides, nerves 10–12 (rarely 7–9 or 13) pairs. Petioles very short 0.1–0.3 cm long. Racemes rather densely appressed rufous hairy in all parts in bud, finally very laxly hairy, never entirely glabrous. Flowers in pairs, slender. Pedicels 4–7 mm long, connate at or above the base. Perianth yellowish, slender, 2–2.3 cm long. Disc glands broadly elliptic or ovate elliptic free and close. Ovary glabrous; style slender. Fruit broadly obliquely ellipsoid or subglobose, mostly shortly apiculate and somewhat contracted at base, 2–4 by 2–3 cm.

description: Tree up to 10 m tall; tip of branchlets dark rufous tomentose, slowly glabrescent, finally glabrous. Leaves obovate-oblong, oblanceolate, or oblong, 15–28 by 6–14 cm, acuminate, subacute or obtuse at the apex, cuneate into the long petiole, margin entire, undulate or coarsely serrate, coriaceous, the upper surface yellowish-green, glabrous, except tomentose midrib, lower surface densely rufous tomentose, sometimes glabrous, midrib prominent on both sides, nerves 9–12 pairs. Petioles rufous tomentose, 1.5–3 cm long. Racemes axillary and subterminal, dense-flowered nearly to the base, rufous tomentose, 8–14 cm long. Flowers in pairs. Pedicels 1–2 mm long, free or connate at base. Perianth red, glabrous inside, 1.6–2 cm long. Disc glands-subquadrate, free, short. Ovary rufous tomentose; style slender, glabrous. Fruit globose, ca 1.5 cm diam.

description: Tree, 4–20 m tall, branches glabrous or nearly so. Leaves simple, oblanceolate, elliptic-oblong or obovate-oblong, apex acute or obtuse, sometimes with a minute mucro, base acuminate and tapering into a long petiole, entire, coriaceous, glabrous, (10–)12–24(–35) cm long, 4–8 cm wide; nerves 7–10 pairs; petiole 1.5–3 cm long. Young leaves pinnatisect, 2–5-lobed, glabrous, 22–50 cm long, 18–36 cm wide; upper surface glossy; petioles 2–3.5(–8) cm long. Racemes axillary, (8–)15–30(–35) cm long. Perianth whitish, fragrant, densely or laxly adpressed rufous-ferruginous pilose. Stamens with short filaments. Disc glands ovate-oblong, free, slightly distant from each other. Ovary glabrous. Fruit ellipsoid, 3–4 cm long, 2–2.5 cm wide.

description: Tree 8–22 m high. Leaves 25–70 cm long; leaflets 3–4 pairs, oblong, elliptic-oblong or ovate-oblong, 9–21 by 5–14 cm, apex bluntly acute to obtuse, rounded at the oblique base, entire, greyish adpressed tomentose beneath, glabrescent to glabrous above; petiolules 1–12 mm long. Thyrse 10–24 cm long. Flowers creamy-white to pale yellow, fragrant, diurnal. Calyx 1.7–3.5 cm long, irregularly 2–3-lobed, yellowish-grey adpressed tomentose. Corolla tube 3.5–5 cm long, narrowly funnel-shaped, with a slightly dilated cylindric base, sparsely stiff-stellate hairy outside, afterwards nearly glabescent. Stamens glabrous at insertion. Ovary yellowish tomentose. Capsule 30–55 cm long, straight, pointed; valves 5–8 cm wide, tawny adpressed tomentose; pseudoseptum ca 3.4 cm broad. Seeds ca 4.3 by 1.8 cm.

description: Shrubby tree. Leaves 2-pinnate; leaflets numerous, oblong, pubescent below, terminal one longer, cuspidate. Inflorescence a loose, spreading, terminal panicle, with numerous flowers. Corolla purplish-blue, 4–5 cm long, slightly curved, pubescent outside. Stamens included, staminode slightly exserted.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small deciduous tree. Rachis of pinnae narrowly winged. Leaves 2-pinnate; leaflets subrhombic-oblong, unequal-sided, apex acute. Inflorescence 5–9 cm long, pyramidal thyrse, on old leafless twigs, sometimes axillary, minutely puberulous to glabrescent. Corolla 3–5 cm long, usually strongly curved in the lower tube, glabrous.

description: Tree with spreading crown. Leaves 1-pinnate, decussate or in whorls of 3–4; leaflets mostly 3–4 pairs, oblong, puberulous to subglabrous on nerves. description: Shrub, usually less than 1 m, rarely up to 4 m. description: Climber. Leaves 2-foliolate, drying dark olive to almost black; tendrils trifid; pseudostipules scale-like, ovate, conical or subulate-lanceoiate. description: Tree. Leaves 1-pinnate, usually with a pair of foliaceous, orbicular pseudostipules; leaflets elliptic-oblong or ovate-oblong; abruptly acuminate, shortly stalked. description: Tree up to 20 m high. Leaflets 12–26 by 6–13 cm, apex acute, acuminate to caudate. Calyx deeply lanate woolly. Racemes 10–25 cm long. Capsule 35–55 cm long, 2.5–3.3 cm broad, woolly hairy.

description: Tree, 7–15 m high; innovation greyish-yellow to tawny floccose. Leaves 40–60 cm long, 5–8-jugate; 7–24 by 4–8 cm, apex acuminate to caudate, base acute, usually glabrous, subsessile. description: Deciduous tree, 5–15 m high; innovation hairy. description: Copiously branched herbs, up to 1 m high; stems terete, greyish pubescent. Leaves ovate, obtuse at apex, attenuate at base, 3–4 by 1.5–2.3 cm, Upper ones smaller. description: Medium-sized tree; bark rough, cracking. description: Woody liana. description: Liana up to 10 m or erect shrub; branches glabrescent. description: Small to medium-sized tree, 5–13(–20) m high, sparingly branched. description: Climber, all parts with strong garlic odour. Corolla pale mauve to pale purple, 3.3–4.5 cm long; basal tube twice as long as calyx, outside of lobes puberulous. Capsule linear, flattened; valves with a prominent central rib.

description: Climbing shrub. Leaflets 5–9, lanceolate or ovate-lanceolate, shortly stalked. Calyx truncate. Corolla tube cylindrical at base, dilating to funnel-shaped above, straight, minutely puberulous outside, pink to pinkish-white.

description: Small tree, 4–7 m high. description: Perennial, tufted herb with well-developed fibrous root. Leaves glabrous, filled with soft parenchyma cells, 40–70 cm long inclusive the basal, 5–20 cm long sheath, 5–15 mm broad. Scape 30–100(–150) cm tall, woolly hairy, particularly towards the inflorescence. Cauline leaves diminishing upwards. Bracts similar to upper leaves, from a broad base gradually tapering towards the subulate apex; reflexed during anthesis. Flowers yellow. Ovary sessile, 6–7 mm long, woolly hairy with numerous ovules; style 3–4 mm long, glabrous; stigma broad triangular. Capsule triangular-oblong, 10 mm long. Seeds numerous, small ca 1 mm long.

description: Climber with tendrils. Leaves and leaflets long stalked, 3-foliolate, or 2-foliolate; leaflets ovate, bluntly acuminate. Thyrse of many, closely packed flowers. Calyx cupular, subtruncate to minutely toothed. Corolla tubular, 4–6 cm long, orange.

description: Small, evergreen, glabrous tree, 4–11 m high. description: Small to medium-sized evergreen tree, 10–25 m high. description: Evergreen tree, 6–15 m high, sometimes partly deciduous. Leaves 2-pinnate, 18–35 cm long, 3–4-jugate; leaflets elliptic-lanceolate, ovate-lanceolate, oblong-lanceolate, 5–12 by 2–4.6 cm usually unequal-sided, glabrous; apex acuminate to caudate; base acute; underpart with crowded minute glands at the base and few in the apical area. description: Evergreen tree 7–18 m high. description: Evergreen tree, 4–20 m high. description: Low trees with pendulous branches; in Thailand mostly evergreen; young twigs puberulous, later glabrous. description: Tree up to 15 m tall with erect branches; in Thailand mostly evergreen; branches glabrous or, particularly when young, ± white puberulous. Leaves on petioles 1–3 cm long, lanceolate, 8–12(–20) by 2–4 cm, serrate; upper surface sparsely hairy to glabrous, lower surface glabrous to densely white pilose. description: Climber with simple tendrils. Leaves 2-foliolate; pseudostipules foliaceous; leaflets obovate with cuneate to decurrent base, bluntly acute at apex. Calyx cupular, truncate, lepidote. description: Tree 6–20 m high. Leaves 1-pinnate, with foliaceous pseudostipules; leaflets 4–8 pairs. Flowers several in a terminal raceme-like thyrse. Calyx spathaceous, ribbed, 4–6 cm long, beaked, thinly velutinous. Corolla orahge-red, broadly campanulate above a cylindric basal tube, 8–12 cm long; Capsule erect, lanceolate-oblong, 15–20 cm long, dehiscing on one side; valves boat-shaped, keeled.

description: Tree 10–25 m high. Leaves 25–45 cm long, 3–4(–6)-jugate; leaflets elliptic, elliptic-oblong, 6–13 by 3–6 cm; base broadly acute or cuneate; margin entire; glabrous, rarely finely puberulous to subglabrous; minutely glandular-punctate below, usually with a few scattered large flat dark glands; petiolules slender, 6–17 mm long. Panicle 20–40 cm long, glabrous or finely puberulous to subglabrous. Flowers fragrant, diurnal. Calyx campanulate, 5–7 mm long, with 3–5 short acute lobes, purple-brown. Corolla dingy yellow, cream within; narrow cylindric basal tube 3–5 mm long, suddenly campanulately widened and curved above, 1.2–1.7 cm long, compressed with the mouth closed and the underside grooved; bilabiate, lobes crisped, the upper two strongly recurved, the lower bearded at the mouth, ochre-buff with purplish stripes, pinkish-purple on the outside. Stamens hairy at insertion. Capsule 9–55 by 0.8–1.2 cm diam, curved or twisted, with 4 prominent ridges. Seeds ca 2 by 0.5 cm.

description: Tree 10–25 m high. Leaves 20–50 cm long, 2–4-jugate; leaflets oblong, elliptic-oblong or broadly elliptic, 6–22 by 3–8 cm; base acute; margin entire; pubescent below with few scattered glands, puberulous above; petiolules 4–18 mm long. Flowers white, nocturnal, several in an erect pubescent raceme-like thyrse, with 2–4 flowers in each cluster, 18–25 cm long; bracts and bracteoles linear to linear-lanceolate. Calyx ± cylindrical, 1.7–2.2 cm long, longitudinally ridged, usually with 3 acuminate lobes, pubescent. Corolla creamy-white, funnel-shaped; tube 5–7 cm long. Stamens glabrous at insertion. Capsule 30–45 by 0.5–0.7 cm diam, with 1 faint median ridge on each valve. Seeds ca 2 by 0.4 cm.

description: Lofty tree up to 35 m high. Leaves 22–47 cm long, 2–4-juflate, viscidglandular, tomentose; leaflets lanceoflate, oflate-lanceoflate or oblong-lanceoflate, 6–14 by 2.5–6 cm; base rounded; margin entire; tawny tomentose on both surfaces, flater glabrescent above; petiolules 5–8 mm long. Panicle 10–30 cm long, viscid glandular, tomentose. Flowers nocturnal. Calyx shortly cylindric, 0.9–1.7 cm long, with 5 pointed lobes, tomentcse. Corolla creamy-white to pinkish-white to pale lilac; funnel-shaped; lobes deeply fringed, lacinflateflat margin; tube 4–5 cm long. Stamens glabrous at insertion. Capsule 30–60 by 0.8–1.1 cm diam, with 1 faint median ridge on each valve. Seeds 1.8–2.3 by 0.7–0.9 cm.

description: Tree 8–20 m high. Leaves 18–40 cm long, 2–3-jugate; leaflets broadly elliptic to suborbicular, elliptic, elliptic-oblong or elliptic-obovate, 11–18 by 5–11 cm; base acute; margin entire (usually crenate in seedlings) finely pubescent; minutely glandular-punctate below, usually with few flat glands; petiolules 1–8 mm long. Thyrse 5–14 cm long, pubescent. Flowers diurnal. Calyx campanulate, 9–15 mm long, with 5 triangular, acute lobes, puberulous, later glabrescent. Corolla greenish-white with a narrow cylindric basal tube, 5–8 mm long, widened to tubular-campanuiate and curved above, 2–2.9 cm long, with the mouth slightly opened; bilabiate, lobes crisped with purple veins inside, the upper two recurved. Stamens hairy at insertion. Capsule 35–50 by 0.6–0.9 cm diam, with 4 faintly raised angles. Seeds ca 2.5 by 0.5 cm.

description: Green herbs, copiously branched, 30–40 cm high; stems quadrangular. Leaves narrowly elliptic, 2.7 cm long; apex acute. Inflorescence slightly corymbose on each branch. Flowers 4-merous, 1.2 cm long. Pedicels 0.5–3 cm long. Calyx lobes 4, narrowly ovate, 6–9 mm long, apex acute. Corolla white or bluish with purple or violet spots; lobes 4, elliptic, 5–14 mm long, margins inflexed, apex acute. Gland 1 per corolla lobe, covered with a small round scale, fimbriate along the margins and shortly hairy at apex, 2.2 by 1.2 mm. Stamens 4; filaments, 2.5 mm long; anthers ovate, 1–2 mm long. Ovary ovoid. Capsule ovoid, 4–8 by 2–3 mm.

description: Copiously branched, green herbs, 8–28 cm high; branches quadrangular. Leaves ovate to elliptic, 2.5 cm long; apex acute. Inflorescence entirely corymbose. Flowers usually 5-merous, rarely 4-merous, 0.7–1.3 cm long. Pedicels 1.5–3.5 cm long (often slightly curved upwards). Calyx lobes 5, rarely 4, elliptic, 4–5 mm long, apex acute. Corolla white with purple veins; lobes 5, rarely 4, ovate, 0.7–1.3 cm long, margins slightly inflexed and flat, apex acute. Glands 2 per corolla-lobe, oblong, surrounded by 0.7 mm long hairs except at the base. Stamens 5 rarely 4, filaments 3–5 mm long; anthers ovate, 1 mm long. Ovary elliptic. Capsule elliptic, 5–8. 5 by 1–3 mm.

description: Green herbs, moderately branched, 30–60 cm high; branches quadrangular. Leaves narrowly elliptic, 3–4 cm long; apex acute. Inflorescence corymbose on each branch. Flowers 5-merous, 0.8–1.2 cm long. Pedicels 0.5–1.5 cm long. Calyx lobes 5, narrowly elliptic, 0.5–0.8 mm long, apex acute. Corolla white with longitudinal purple veins; lobes 5, 8–10 mm long, margins inflexed, apex acute. Glands 2 per corolla-lobe, oblong, surrounded by 2 mm long hairs except at the base. Stamens 5; filaments 4–5 mm long; anthers elliptic, 1–3 mm long. Ovary oblong. Capsule oblong, 7–10 by 1–2 mm.

description: Deciduous tree. Leaves palmately compound; leaflets elliptic-oblong or oblong, abruptly acuminate, stellate-hairy below. Flowers many in a contracted terminal thyrse. Calyx campanulate, shallowly 5-lobed, rusty stellate pubescent. Corolla yellow, tubular-infundibuliform, 4–7 cm long. Stamens hairy at insertion.

description: Shrub or small tree. Leaves palmately compound, very variable, ofen 1–3-foliolate, rarely 5-foliolate; leaflets elliptic to elliptic-oblong or obovate, apex obtuse, lepidote. Inflorescence terminal, few-flowered, often reduced to 1 or 2 flowers. Calyx cupular, bilabiate, minutely lepidote. Corolla pinkish-lavender to almost white, the throat opening yellow.

description: Deciduous tree. Leaves palmately 5-foliolate; leaflets elliptic to elliptic-oblong, usually unequal, apex acuminate, lepidote. Calyx cupular, bilabiate, minutely lepidote. Corolla pinkish-white, pink to pinkish-lavender, the throat opening yellow, turning white.

description: Erect shrub. Leaves 1-pinnate; leaflets 1–3 pairs, lanceolate, subsessile to sessile. Raceme 5–12 cm long, glabrous. Calyx campanulate; lobes shortly ciliate. Corolla tubular-campanulate above a narrowed basal tube, tube yellow with reddish lines in the throat. Stamens hairy at insertion. Capsule linear, subterete, 7–18 by 0.5–0.7 cm.

description: Stem erect simple rarely branched up to 12 cm, 1– few-flowered. Leaves scale-like, lanceolate to ovate, 3 mm long. Involucral bracts 3, orange. Perianth-tube urceolate, pale orange with darker stripes, with longitudinal bars inside connected by several transverse bars; outer perianth-lobes orange, ovate, inner ones triangular, terminated by a 2–3 cm long appendage. Anthers 3-toothed at the free apical margin, each tooth terminated by a hair; connective broad with a quadrangular appendage. Ovary obovoid; style short; stigma truncate. Fruit orange, 6 mm long. description: Stem white, erect, simple up to 7 cm high, 1–2-flowered. Perianth-tube urceolate, bluish-black; outer perianth lobes white, broad liguliform with mucronate apex, inner ones connate to a flat-topped mitre with three openings, the flat top with a 3-partite fovea. Anthers pendulous from the annulus; connective broad with a quadrangular plicate appendage. Style short; stigma 3-partite. Fruits unknown.

description: Shrublet, about 1 m high, rusty tomentose; branches zigzag, woody, nodes thickened. Leaves with petiole 5–8 mm, tomentose; lamina obovate-oblong, oblong, elliptic-oblong or lanceolate, 26–33.5 by 8.5–17.5 cm, base rounded or slightly cordate, margin entire, apex acute or acuminate, glabrous above, laxly tomentose below, pinnately 6–7-nerved, veins transverse, venation reticulate, smooth above, strongly prominent below. Inflorescences axillary, racemose, 7–10 cm long, 3–5-flowered, drooping, from the middle or near basal part of the stem; bracts leafy, ovate, 7–9 by 2.5–3 mm, tomentose, many. Flowers with 1.5–2.5 cm, pedicels, deep purple. Perianth campanulate, large, 5–10 cm long, tomentose outside, glabrous inside, longitudinal veined, without disc. Stamens 36(–46), orange, arranged in 2 series, anthers oblong ± 1.5 by 0.75–0.8 mm, connective deep maroon when fresh, brown when dry. Gynostemium 2.7–4 by 4.7–7 mm, stigmatic lobes 8–15, long triangular, flattened, brown. Fruit long, ± 10 by ± 0.8 cm, straight when mature, narrow at the base, 4-angular; pedicel villous, 0.8–1.2 cm. Seeds ellipsoid; trigonous ± 5.5 by ± 3.5 mm, greyish light brown.

description: Shrublet about 1 m high, branches pubescent. Leaves with petiole 0.55–0.75 cm, grooved above, pubescent; lamina ovate, obovate, elliptic or oblong, 16.5–22 by 7–9.5 cm, base cuneate or rounded, margin entire, apex acute or acuminate, glabrous above, pubescent below, pinnately 7–8-nerved, veins transverse, venation reticulate, obscurely above, strongly prominent below. Inflorescences axillary, racemose, 0.8–2 cm long; bracts ovate or lanceolate, 1.5–2 by 0.5–0.8 mm, hairy outside. Flowers with 0.25–1 cm pedicels, very slender, densely pubescent. Perianth patent 4 by 3 mm, ± 7 mm diam., hairy outside, pink or violet; without disc. Stamens many, arranged in 4 series; anther oblong 0.7–0.8 by 0.5–0.6 mm, connective and filaments hooked hairy. Gynostemium ± 1 by ± 2.5 mm, stigmatic lobes 4–8, cylindrical, glabrous. Fruit elongate, 4–7 by 0.3–0.5 cm, base and apex narrowed, 4-angled, peduncle 3–7 mm. Seeds ellipsoid, distinctly trigonous ± 3.3 by ± 1.7 mm, light brown.

description: Undershrub about 1 m high. Leaves with petiole 0.6–1 cm, laxly hairy; lamina oblong-lanceolate, 23–27 by 4.5–7 cm, base obtuse or rounded, margin entire, apex acute or acuminate, glabrous above, laxly tomentose below, pinnately 8–9-nerved, tertiary veins transverse, venation reticulate, ± conspicuous above, prominent below. Inflorescences axillary, racemose, 4–5 cm long; bract oblong-lanceolate, 7–8 by 1.3–1.8 mm, hairy outside, glabrous inside; veined, many along the axis. Flowers with ± 1 cm pedicel, dirty yellowish-white outside, blackish-red inside. Perianth tube short, ± 5 mm, deeply 3-lobed, lobes ± 14 mm; without disc. Stamens 6, arranged in one series; anther oblong ± 2.5 by 0.5 mm, with glabrous connective protruding 0.5–1 mm at the apex. Gynostemium 3–4 mm, stigmatic lobes 3, long conical, glabrous. Fruit very long, slender, 10–14 by 0.3–0.4 cm, violet black; pedicel ± 0.5 cm. Seeds ellipsoid, trigonous, 4.3–4.6 by 2–2.2 mm, light brown.

description: Undershrub about 30 cm high, bearing 1–5 (mostly 2 or 3) leaves at the apical part. Leaves with petiole 4.5–6.5 mm, hairy; lamina elliptic, oblong, ovate to broadly ovate, 11.3–13.7 by 8.7–10.7 cm, base cuneate, rounded, slightly obliquely cordate, margin entire, apex acute, acuminate or obtuse, glabrous above, densely cobwebby tomentose or villous below, pinnately 7–8-nerved, venation reticulate, smooth above, prominent below. Inflorescences near the base of the stem, racemose, 5–9 cm long, slightly drooping; bracts lanceolate, 3.7–5 by 0.7–1.2 mm, tomentose, many along the axis. Flowers with 0.6–0.8 cm pedicel, purplish-brown outside, yellowish-brown inside. Perianth cup-shaped, 5–8 by 4–7 mm, 3-lobed, lobes patent. Disk cupular, adnate to perianth tube with apical part free and ring-like. Stamens 6, arranged in 1 series; anther oblong, 1.6–2 by 0.5 mm, connective glabrous. Gynostemium ± 2.6 by 2 mm, stigmatic lobes 3, elongate, apical part hooked hairy. Fruits elongate, with 4 distinct valves, 3.5–4.5 by 0.35–0.45 cm, dark purple; pedicel ± 0.7 cm. Seeds oblong, distinctly trigonous, 3.5–4 by 2–2.2 mm, brown.

description: Small tree up to 4 m (sometimes climbing). Leaves lanceolate-elliptic to narrowly lanceolate, rarely ovate or obovate, (7–)11–18(–23) by (3–)4–6(–7) cm; apex acuminate or acute, base cuneate; petiole 1–3 mm. Flowers usually 3 per bract, without bracteoles (rarely 4 flowers per bract and then with 2 small bracteoles); pedicels 3–5 mm. Tepals greenish-yellow, 3 mm. Stamens white, filaments 4–5 mm; anthers elliptic, ca 1 mm. Disc broadly protruding-annular. Ovary cylindric, the upper part subconical, 1–1.5 mm. Drupe red, 13–15 by 7–9 mm; pedicel 5–6 mm.

description: Shrub or small tree up to 5 m. Leaves narrowly ovate to elliptic (6–)8–12(–18) by 2.5–4(–6) cm; apex mostly acuminate, base attenuate or obtuse; petiole 2–3 mm. Inflorescence on young and older branches in the axils of present or fallen leaves, usually solitary, sometimes in two; rhachis 2.5–4 cm (fruiting up to 6 cm). Bracts broadly ovate to triangular, apex obtuse or apiculate, base subcordate, 4 by 5 mm. Flowers mostly 3 per bract, without bracteoles; pedicels 1.5–2 mm. Tepals greenish-yellow to whitish, ca 2 mm. Stamens white; filaments ca 2 mm; anthers elliptic, ca 0.5 mm. Disc-green, annular. Ovary conical, ca 1 mm. Drupe apiculate, bright red, 8–10 by 6.5–8 mm; pedicel 2–4 mm.

description: Erect herb up to 1.5 m high with a horizontal rhizome 5–10 mm thick; stem terete, hollow, finely pubescent to glabrous. Leaves imparipinnate or deeply pinnatifid, 5–15 cm long, 2–8 cm broad with 3–5 narrow lanceolate, to broad ovate-cordate, coarsely serrate segments; very variable in leaf size and shape. Inflorescence a terminal panicie, 10–60 cm long, often richly branched with numerous, small flowers. Flowering bracts subulate, 3–4 mm long. Calyx disc-like, poorly developed during anthesis. Corolla white, tube ca 2 mm long, segments as long as tube with rounded apex. Stamens 2–3 mm; filament 1–2 mm inserted in the corolla tube. Ovary pubescent; style 2–3 mm. Achene light brown, compressed with 6–8 ridges between which appressed, bristle-like, 3 mm long hairs occur; pappus segments ca 10, plumose, 4–5 mm long.

description: Leaves with or without a ligule, margins not thickened but sometimes distinctly sharp-edged; apex blunt to acute, slightly oblique, 3–70 cm by 0.5–1.5 mm; blade subterete to almost flat. Scape terete or subterete with 1–2 low ridges, 15–100 cm by 0.5–1.5 mm. Inflorescence ellipsoid, 0.6–1.2 by 0.5–0.8 mm. Median bracts with margin lacerate above near apex, greenish-brown to dark-brown; greenish-greyish-brown, triangular-elliptic field below apex 1.5–2 by 1–1.5 mm with numerous lighter spots; surface of bract ± finely tuberculate, at least in triangular field but often in entire upper half, often with narrow ridge below apex. Median bracts with margin entire, blackish-brown to light brown, smooth except for a ± conspicuous longitudinal keel dorsally just below apex, keel up to ⅓ the length of bract. description: Leaves with sheaths dark brownish-black, ligule present; margins thickened and rough on the edge due to numerous retrorsely pointing, coalescent rows of cells, the distal cell in each row forming a small tubercle (large magnification), 25–60 cm by 1.8–4 mm; apex acute, oblique; blade flat. description: Leaves without a ligule, margins conspicuously widened but hardly thickened; apex bluntly-oblique, (7–)10–25(–38) cm by (3.5–)4–6(–7.5) mm; blade flat. description: Leaves with or without a ligule, margins thickened or not; apex bluntly-oblique to acute, (2.5–)5–25(–33) cm by 0.5–3.7 mm; blade flat with epidermis often tuberculate. Scape terete, with or without ridges, (8–)10–30(–44) cm by 0.3–1.5(–1.8) mm. Inflorescence ellipsoid, 0.4–1(–1.4) by 0.2–0.7(–1.2)cm. description: Tubers subglobose, in aggregates up to 1.2 cm diam., containing starch grains. Leaves with a small ligule or ligule absent, margins distinctly thickened; apex bluntly-oblique to acute, 5–4 cm by 1.4–4.5 mm; blade flat. Scape terete, without ridges, 15–40 cm by 1–2 mm. Inflorescence spherical to ellipsoid, 0.7–1.8 by 0.7–1.3 cm. Median bracts with margin entire, shining brown to dark brown, with triangular grey field below apex 1.8–2.6 by 1.4–2.6 mm, field with lighter spots. Lateral sepals thin, hyaline, crest broad, very thin, coarsely and distantly serrate.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Xyris tuberosa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 1, 1987. Pg. 137. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Leaves: sheath with margin ± ciliate below, without a ligule, margins not thickened; apex bluntly oblique to acute, 5–30 cm by 1.5–4.6 mm; blade flat. Scape terete without ridges to slightly compressed above with 1–2 shallow ridges, 5–40 cm by 0.3–1.4 mm. Inflorescence ellipsoid, 0.4–1.1 by 0.2–0.6 cm. Median bracts with margin entire, light brown to brown, oblong-triangular greyish-brown field below apex 1.7–3.2 by 0.3–1.2 mm, not protruding upwards, on each side with a narrowly triangular hyaline area widening upwards. Lateral sepals light brown, not hyaline, with narrow, brown, entire crest.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Xyris wallichii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 1, 1987. Pg. 136. Accessed 2021-07-31
